products.name: AI Foundations Bootcamp
products.tagline: Learn to build with AI in 4 weeks
products.description: A 4-week live bootcamp that takes students and junior developers from AI basics to a working project: prompting, APIs, simple agents and deployment.
faq_seed: When do the sessions take place?
What is the difference between Standard and Pro?

policies.refund: Refund within 7 days if fewer than 2 sessions attended.
policies.schedule: Sessions run Monday to Thursday, 18:00-20:00 Tunisia time, for 4 weeks.
policies.prerequisites: Basic Python knowledge is helpful; no prior AI experience is required.
policies.certificate: A certificate of completion is issued to students who attend at least 12 of 16 sessions.

products.name: Data Analytics Sprint
products.tagline: Turn raw data into decisions in 6 weeks
products.description: A live analytics sprint for analysts and developers who want a repeatable path from messy data to dashboards, models and a decision-ready story.

policies.refund: Full refund before the second live lab.
policies.schedule: Two evening sessions per week for 6 weeks.
policies.prerequisites: Comfort with spreadsheets; basic Python is a plus.
policies.certificate: Certificate issued after the capstone review.

products.name: AI Automation Studio
products.tagline: Ship your first AI workflow, at your own pace
products.description: A self-paced studio with guided builds for founders and operators who want to automate real work with prompts, APIs and lightweight agents.
faq_seed: Can I use my own tools?
How long do I keep access?

policies.refund: Refund within 14 days if less than 25 percent of the material is completed.
policies.schedule: Self-paced, with two live office hours every month.
policies.prerequisites: No coding required for the first track; API basics for the advanced builds.
policies.certificate: Completion badge after four guided builds.

products.name: Enterprise AI Enablement
products.tagline: Bring your whole team up to speed on AI
products.description: A tailored enablement programme for teams: workshops, role-specific playbooks and a guided pilot that turns AI from a side experiment into a working capability.
faq_seed: Can it use our own tools?

policies.refund: Engagement can be paused before the second workshop at no cost.
policies.schedule: Four workshops over two months, scheduled with your team.
policies.prerequisites: No prior AI experience required; one internal sponsor is needed.
policies.certificate: Team completion report and individual certificates.

products.name: Solo Maker AI Toolkit
products.tagline: A compact AI toolkit for one-person businesses
products.description: A low-cost, weekend-friendly toolkit for solo makers: prompts, automations and a small project that puts an AI feature in front of real users fast.
faq_seed: How much time does it take?

policies.refund: Refund within 7 days, no questions asked.
policies.schedule: Self-paced; the core path fits in one weekend.
policies.prerequisites: No coding required; curiosity is enough.
policies.certificate: Completion badge after publishing one project.
